title: How Cold Does It Get on a Sunset Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Mild, but cooler than the beach. Evening air in Funchal runs from the mid-teens in winter to the low 20s in summer, and the moving boat makes it feel cooler.
heroAlt: Two guests pulling on jackets on a boat deck just after sunset off Ribeira Brava
keywords: how cold does it get on a sunset boat trip in Madeira
what to wear on a sunset boat trip Madeira
do I need a jacket on a boat in Madeira
